title: SimpleSpawnPlugin
body:
Simple Spawn Plugin for Paper 1.21

This lightweight plugin offers a reliable spawn solution for modern Minecraft servers. It was specifically developed for version 1.21 and uses the latest Paper API for maximum performance.

Player Features
The spawn command allows players to return to the starting point. To maintain game balance, a 10 second countdown is included. Players must stand perfectly still or the process will cancel. Additionally, a 30 second global cooldown prevents users from spamming the command.

Admin Features
With the setspawn command, administrators or operators can set the spawn point exactly at their current location including their view direction. All data is securely saved in the config file so the point remains available immediately after a server restart.

Technical Highlights
The plugin avoids unnecessary code, advertisements, or background processes. It uses modern components for a clean display in chat and the action bar. Installation is very simple. Just upload the jar file, start the server, and you are ready. It is ideal for survival or freebuild servers looking for a simple but professional solution.

Commands
spawn Teleport to the starting point for everyone
setspawn Sets the spawn point for operators only
